title: Move the box
instructions:
Use as few steps
as possible to 
move all boxes 
to the target.

The max. score is
200 for one level.
A step will lower
your score by 1.

To reset the game
use right-top key.
To undo one step,
use left-top key.

Enable the option
"Rotate map" will
rotate screen
diagonally every
50 steps.
